name: Observational studies of exposures (ROBINS-E structure)
about: Key provides the assessment structure: seven domains, the judgement scale and a worst-domain overall default. The questions and the decision algorithms are in the official tool: open it beside Key, answer there, and record each domain's judgement and its basis here.
licence: ROBINS-E © the authors, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (stated at https://www.riskofbias.info/welcome/rob-2-0-tool for RoB 2, ROBINS-I, ROBINS-E and ROB-ME, checked 2026-11-27). Key ships none of its text: only neutral domain labels of its own and a link.

overall.note: Key's default suggestion is the most severe domain; the official guidance decides the overall judgement.
